method: single-frequency ansatz f = F(r) cos(omega t); cycle-averaged full Lagrangian by midpoint quadrature in theta (K = 96); shooting; continuation in (ln eps, ln x), x = F'(0), through folds (fixed omega or fixed x, whichever the tangent favours)

definitions.N: dLbar/domega = int 4 pi r^2 omega F^2 <2 sin^2 P'(X)> (adiabatic invariant)
definitions.E: omega N - Lbar (cycle-averaged energy, on shell)
definitions.hw: radius where F falls to half its peak (pinch: outer half maximum)
definitions.nonlinear_share_signed: 1 - <E_quad>/E, E_quad = cycle average of int 4 pi r^2 (f_t^2/2 + S/2 + f^2/2) in (f, f_t) (the same definition as the run logs)
definitions.X_max_cycle: max over r and the cycle of X = omega^2 F^2 (R: must be < 1)
definitions.derrick_rel: (3 Lbar + int 4 pi r^2 T A) / int 4 pi r^2 T A, zero on shell
definitions.dE_domega: along the curve, (dE/ds)/(domega/ds) by central differences
definitions.identity_rel: |dE/domega - omega dN/domega| / max(...) (finite differences along the curve; zero exactly; large only at folds)
definitions.E_start_t0: energy of the evolution start f = F, f_t = 0

end.reason_raw: stopped by hand after 102 points (about 20 min): the upper branch runs to omega -> 1 at fixed core (F'(0) -> 0.5194, F_peak 0.985, hw 4.48); each further point integrates to r ~ 60/eps and slows down
